children: Our Bureau New Delhi: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with the heads of top three Indian business conglomerates - Ambanis, Adanis and the Tatas - in a sign of deepening business relationship between the two countries, where Reliance Industries Ltd may become the pivot in the two nations' energy ties. Rubio met Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani and Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran in Mumbai ahead of the US midterm election next month.

title: Rubio Visits RIL Refinery in Guj
